summary: Comprehensive testing of new features: Reservation system, Reviews system, and Admin panel. All 20 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed including reservation form, reviews section, admin panel login/management, and mobile navigation.

Backend: POST /api/reviews creates unapproved review
Backend: Review validation rejects invalid data

seed_data_creation: 4 sample reviews seeded on startup (Martin K., Jana M., Thomas W., Petra S.). Test reservations and reviews created during testing were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Reservation system, Reviews system, Admin panel) are fully functional. Backend uses JWT auth for admin endpoints. Reviews require admin approval before appearing publicly. Reservation form uses shadcn Calendar component with date-fns for Slovak/English/German locales. Admin panel is accessed via shield icon in footer. Mobile navigation includes Rezervácie and Recenzie links. All data is stored in MongoDB (reservations, reviews, contact_messages, users collections).
